providers.bitbucket.field.space.label: U kʼaabaʼ a kúuchil meyaj
providers.bitbucket.field.space.help: Le kʼaabaʼ kóom ku chíikpajal tu beelil webeʼ, tu paach bitbucket.org/
providers.bitbucket.field.space.missing: Kʼaʼabet u kʼaabaʼ a kúuchil meyaj: le kʼaabaʼ kóom ku chíikpajal tu beelil webeʼ, tu paach bitbucket.org/
providers.bitbucket.token_help: Tiʼ Bitbucket, oken tu nuʼukbesajil a kúuchil meyaj, jeʼej «Access tokens» ka beetej jumpʼéel, chéen a chʼíik u chaʼaniloʼob xook (Read) tiʼ «Repositories» yéetel «Projects». Yéetel leloʼ le appaʼ ku yilik tuláakal a noj meyajoʼob yéetel a repositorioʼob maʼ tu páajtal u kʼexik mix baʼal. Maʼ u token juntúul máakiʼ: u tiʼal le kúuchiloʼ, ka máax kanáantikeʼ jeʼel u páajtal u xuʼulsik le kéen u kʼáatoʼ.
providers.bitbucket.login_help: Bitbucketeʼ maʼ tu chaʼik u yéejentaʼal lelaʼ tiʼ le navegadoroʼ, le beetikoʼ le tokenoʼ ku tsʼáabal tu kʼab máak. Tu jeeleʼ, ku beetaʼal chéen yéetel chaʼanil xook ka ku meyaj tiʼ tuláakal le kúuchil meyajoʼ.
providers.bitbucket.area_help: Beey u muchʼkíintik Bitbucket u código a molaʼayoʼ — teʼeloʼ ku kʼaabaʼtik noj meyajoʼob.
providers.github.token_help: Kʼaʼabet u chaʼanil xook tiʼ código yéetel tiʼ molaʼayoʼob. A tiʼal ka chéen a tiʼal: maʼ a meyajtik jumpʼéel u tiʼal tuláakal le molaʼayoʼ.
providers.github.login_help.paste: Le kaʼatsʼíibil le appaʼ maʼ tu páajtal u jeʼesik teech u yokol GitHub tak bejlaʼeʼ, le beetikoʼ wayeʼ le tokenoʼ ku tsʼáabal tu kʼab máak. Tu jeeleʼ, jeʼel u páajtal a beetik yéetel chaʼanil chéen utiʼal xook.
providers.github.error.no_client_id_hint: Le kaʼatsʼíibil le appaʼ minaʼan u nuʼukbesajil chaʼanil utiʼal u jeʼesik u yokol GitHub. Nupʼej yéetel jumpʼéel token le táan u paʼataloʼ.
providers.github.error.no_client_id: Le kaʼatsʼíibil le appaʼ minaʼan u nuʼukbesajil chaʼanil utiʼal u jeʼesik u yokol GitHub.
providers.github.error.device_refused: GitHubeʼ maʼ tu kʼáataj u jeʼesik le chaʼanil tiʼ le appaʼ. Nupʼej yéetel jumpʼéel token le táan u paʼataloʼ.
providers.github.error.expired: Máan yaʼab kʼiin ka GitHubeʼ tu xuʼulsaj le chaʼaniloʼ. Kaʼa káajsej.
providers.github.error.denied: Maʼ tsʼáabak le chaʼanil tiʼ GitHuboʼ. Wa maʼ ta kʼáataj beyoʼ, kaʼa káajsej.
providers.github.error.unfinished: GitHubeʼ maʼ tu tsʼoʼoksaj u tsʼáaik le chaʼaniloʼ. Kaʼa káajsej, wa nupʼej yéetel jumpʼéel token.
providers.http.unreadable: {name} tu núukaj baʼax maʼ tin páajtal in xokik. Beetej tu kaʼatéen ichil jumpʼéel súutuk.
providers.http.timeout: {name} maʼ tu núukaj tu kʼiinil. Ilej a nupʼil ka beetej tu kaʼatéen.
providers.http.no_connection: Maʼ páajchaj in tʼaan yéetel {name}. Ilej a nupʼil ka beetej tu kaʼatéen — wa yanech tu chʼeʼochʼeʼil le meyajtsiloʼ, maʼ xaan kʼaʼabet le VPNoʼ.
providers.http.token_unknown: {name} maʼ u kʼaj óol le tokenoʼ. Ilej wa ta kaʼatsʼíibtaj tuláakal ka wa maʼ tsʼoʼok u kʼiiniliʼ, ka tsʼáaʼ tu kaʼatéen.
providers.http.token_expired: U nupʼil {name} pʼáat maʼ tu meyaj: le tokenoʼ tsʼoʼok u kʼiinil wa yaan máax tu xuʼulsaj. Beetej jumpʼéel túumben ka kaʼa nupʼej.
providers.http.rate_limited: {name} táan u xotik le kʼáatchiʼoʼob bejlaʼeʼ. Paʼatej jaypʼéel minuto ka beetej tu kaʼatéen.
providers.http.server_error: {name} maʼ tu núukik maʼalob bejlaʼeʼ. Beetej tu kaʼatéen ichil jumpʼíit kʼiin.
providers.http.no_read_permission: Le tokenoʼ maʼ tu chukik utiʼal u xoʼokol lelaʼ. Tsʼáaʼ tiʼ u chaʼanil xook tiʼ {name} ka kaʼa nupʼej.
providers.http.not_found: {name} maʼ tu kaxtaj leloʼ. Ilej u kʼaabaʼ kóom a molaʼay — letiʼ ku chíikpajal tu beelil webeʼ, maʼ le kʼaabaʼ chowakoʼ.
providers.http.rejected_query: {name} tu pʼataj le kʼáatchiʼoʼ. Beetej tu kaʼatéen; wa láayliʼeʼ, ilej le tokenoʼ.
providers.error.unknown_provider: Le molaʼayoʼ minaʼan tiʼ le u jaatsil le appaʼ.
providers.error.not_connected: Maʼ ta nupʼaj {name} tak bejlaʼeʼ. Nupʼej teʼ kaʼanaloʼ ka beetej tu kaʼatéen.
providers.error.data_dir: Maʼ páajchaj in jeʼesik u kúuchil datos le appaʼ. Kaʼa jeʼej ka beetej tu kaʼatéen.
providers.error.save_connection_disk: Maʼ páajchaj in kanáantik le nupʼil tiʼ le computadoraaʼ. Ilej wa le appaʼ yaan u chaʼanil tsʼíib tu kúuchil datos.
providers.error.save_connection: Maʼ páajchaj in kanáantik le nupʼiloʼ.
providers.error.no_git_bundled: Maʼ tin kaxtaj git tiʼ le computadoraaʼ ka le kin taasikoʼ maʼ xan páajchaj u nuʼukbesaʼal.
providers.error.no_git: Maʼ tin kaxtaj git tiʼ le computadoraaʼ.
providers.error.fetch_updates: Maʼ páajchaj in taasik baʼax túumben tiʼ le repositorioʼ. Ilej wa a nupʼil láayliʼ yaan u yokol tiʼiʼ.
providers.error.pr_unreadable_url: Maʼ páajchaj in kʼaj óoltik baʼax repositorioil lelaʼ tu beelil, le beetikoʼ maʼ tin jeʼesaj le pull requestoʼ. Le kʼaboʼ jóokʼ: jeʼel u páajtal a jeʼesik tiʼ le webeʼ.
providers.error.no_branches: Le repositorioʼ minaʼan mix jumpʼéel kʼab jeʼel in taasikeʼ.
providers.error.no_default_branch: Maʼ páajchaj in wojéeltik baʼax le kʼab noj. Ilej wa le repositorioʼ yaan u kʼab noj nuʼukbesaʼan.
providers.error.branches_connected: Maʼ páajchaj in kʼáatik u kʼaboʼob le repositorioʼ. Ilej wa a nupʼil láayliʼ yaan u yokol tiʼiʼ.
providers.error.branches_public: Maʼ páajchaj in kʼáatik u kʼaboʼob le repositorioʼ. Ilej le beeliloʼ ka wa jeʼekʼabil tiʼ tuláakal.
providers.error.clone_connected: Maʼ páajchaj in taasik le repositorioʼ. Ilej wa a nupʼil láayliʼ yaan u yokol tiʼiʼ.
providers.error.clone_public: Maʼ páajchaj in taasik le repositorioʼ. Ilej le beeliloʼ, ka wa jeʼekʼabil tiʼ tuláakal: wa minaʼan nupʼil nupʼaʼaneʼ minaʼan yéetel baʼax u kʼáataʼal chaʼanil.
